name: 鉄道駅一覧 (日本)
title: 鉄道駅一覧 (日本)
description: 日本全国の鉄道駅の一覧（座標・住所・所属路線・所属都道府県を含む）。Comprehensive list of railway stations in Japan with geographic coordinates, postal address (administrative area / locality / sublocalities), the railway lines serving each station, and the prefectures the station belongs to.
